lines: Be-sabab baat badhaane ki zaroorat kya hai?
couplets.en: Why make more of this without cause?

lines: Be-sabab baat badhaane ki zaroorat kya hai?

couplets.en: Why make more of this when I never took offence?

lines: Aap ke dam se to duniya ka bharam hai qaayam
couplets.en: It is you who keep the world's illusion alive.

lines: Aap ke dam se to duniya ka bharam hai qaayam
Aap jab hain to zamaane ki zaroorat kya hai?
couplets.en: You alone keep the world's illusion alive, so what need have I of the world when you are here?

lines: Tera koocha, tera dar, teri gali kaafi hai
couplets.en: Your quarter, your doorstep, your lane are enough.

lines: Tera koocha, tera dar, teri gali kaafi hai
Be-thikaanon ko thikaane ki zaroorat kya hai?
couplets.en: Your quarter, your doorstep, your lane are enough, so what need have wanderers of a place to call their own?

lines: Dil se milne ki tamanna hi nahin jab dil mein
